question: New Development Bank (NDB) is a multilateral development bank established in 2014. How many countries are members of NDB?
solution:
The correct answer is 9__**.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **New Development Bank (NDB)** is a multilateral development bank established in** 2014.**
 
• It is formerly referred to as the **BRICS Development Bank.**
 
• New Development Bank was established by the **BRICS states.**
 
• New Development Bank consists of 9** member countries.**__
 
• In July 2015, the New Development Bank Agreement came into force with the official declaration of all five states who signed it.
 
• Through loans, guarantees, equity participation, and other financial instruments, the Bank will support public and private projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa **are among the Bank's five founding members. and Recently 4 new members joined BRICS. Those are Bangladesh, UAE, Uruguay, Egypt.
 
• The headquarters of the New Development Bank is located in **Shanghai, China.**
 
• The National Development Bank's first regional office is in **Johannesburg, South Africa.**
 
• In 2019, So Paulo, Brazil, became the second regional office, followed by Moscow, Russia.
 
• As of November 2021, **Marcos Troyjo** is the President of the New Development Bank (NDB).
 
• India suggested the establishment of the bank at the** 4th BRICS meeting in Delhi in 2012.**
 
• India's **K. V. Kamath** is the NDB's first elected president.
